name: whiteboard-app-ui
description: Component-mode frontend for aw-app-whiteboard — owns BOTH the Whiteboard row inside the Workspace nav popover (core.nav.workspace) AND the full floating window body (core.window.body:whiteboard.main, toolbar + live-synced iframe), per the 2026-08-04 decision that aw-workspace-ui must carry zero app-specific window/nav logic. src/plugin.jsx is the integrated-mode entry (register(host)), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle consumed by aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle.
